<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_UniversityEnrollment" targetNamespace="http://example.org/university-enrollment">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_UniversityEnrollment" name="University Enrollment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Enrollment">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Student" name="Student">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Application</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideMissingDocs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmEnrollment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ObtainStudentID</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_StudyPlan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AttendClasses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AddDropSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddDropCourses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AddDropMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewGrades</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_GrievanceSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Appeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_GrievanceMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SemesterRepeat</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Graduated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Withdrawn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AdmissionsOffice" name="Admissions Office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DocsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMissingDocs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DocsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_EvalFork</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_EvalJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Decision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendAcceptance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRejection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ConfirmDeadline</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CancelApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Canceled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OnboardFork</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendOrientation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OnboardJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AdmissionsCommittee" name="Admissions Committee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Finance" name="Finance Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessFees</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IT" name="IT Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetupAccounts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PostGrades</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_InternationalOffice" name="International Student Office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_IntlSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_VisaProcessing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_IntlMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Start and application submission -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Application" name="Application started">
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit online application" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewApplication" name="Review application and supporting documents" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DocsSplit" name="Documents complete?" default="Flow_DocsComplete" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyMissingDocs" name="Notify applicant of missing documents" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideMissingDocs" name="Provide missing documents" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DocsMerge" name="Documents received" />

    <!-- Concurrent evaluation and fee processing -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_EvalFork" name="Start evaluation and fee processing" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EvaluateApplication" name="Evaluate application" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessFees" name="Process application fees or waivers" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_EvalJoin" name="Evaluation and fee processing complete" />

    <!-- Decision -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision" name="Application accepted?" default="Flow_Rejected" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAcceptance" name="Send acceptance letter" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRejection" name="Send rejection letter" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Rejected" name="Application rejected" />

    <!-- Enrollment confirmation -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfirmEnrollment" name="Confirm enrollment by deadline" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ConfirmDeadline" name="Enrollment confirmed by deadline?" default="Flow_DeadlineMissed" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CancelApplication" name="Cancel application" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Canceled" name="Application canceled" />

    <!-- Onboarding -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OnboardFork" name="Start onboarding" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOrientation" name="Send orientation materials" />
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_SetupAccounts" name="Set up email, portal and library accounts" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IntlSplit" name="International student?" default="Flow_NotInternational" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_VisaProcessing" name="Assist with visa processing" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IntlMerge" name="International check complete" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OnboardJoin" name="Onboarding complete" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ObtainStudentID" name="Obtain student ID card" />

    <!-- Study plan (embedded subprocess) -->
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_StudyPlan" name="Create study plan">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_StudyPlan" />
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_MeetAdvisor" name="Meet with academic advisor" />
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourses" name="Select courses" />
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ResolveConflicts" name="Resolve schedule conflicts" />
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StudyPlan" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_StudyPlan" targetRef="Task_MeetAdvisor" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_MeetAdvisor" targetRef="Task_SelectCourses" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourses" targetRef="Task_ResolveConflicts" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SP_Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_ResolveConflicts" targetRef="EndEvent_StudyPlan" />
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <!-- Semester activities -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AttendClasses" name="Attend classes" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddDropSplit" name="Add or drop courses in add/drop period?" default="Flow_NoAddDrop" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddDropCourses" name="Add or drop courses" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddDropMerge" name="Add/drop check complete" />
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PostGrades" name="Post grades at end of semester" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewGrades" name="Review grades online" />

    <!-- Grievance / appeal -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GrievanceSplit" name="Grievance to file?" default="Flow_NoGrievance" />
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Appeal" name="File and process appeal">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Appeal" />
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitAppealForm" name="Submit appeal form" />
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee" name="Meet with appeals committee" />
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AwaitAppealDecision" name="Await decision" />
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Appeal" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="AP_Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Appeal" targetRef="Task_SubmitAppealForm" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="AP_Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SubmitAppealForm" targetRef="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="AP_Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee" targetRef="Task_AwaitAppealDecision" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="AP_Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_AwaitAppealDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_Appeal" />
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GrievanceMerge" name="Grievance handling complete" />

    <!-- Semester repetition and exit -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SemesterRepeat" name="Graduated or withdrawn?" default="Flow_NextSemester" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Graduated" name="Student graduated" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Withdrawn" name="Student withdrew" />

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitApplication" sourceRef="StartEvent_Application" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewApplication" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Task_ReviewApplication" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToDocsSplit" sourceRef="Task_ReviewApplication" targetRef="Gateway_DocsSplit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocsMissing" name="Documents missing" sourceRef="Gateway_DocsSplit" targetRef="Task_NotifyMissingDocs">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${documentsMissing}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyToProvide" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMissingDocs" targetRef="Task_ProvideMissingDocs" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProvideToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ProvideMissingDocs" targetRef="Gateway_DocsMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocsComplete" name="Documents complete" sourceRef="Gateway_DocsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_DocsMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToEvalFork" sourceRef="Gateway_DocsMerge" targetRef="Gateway_EvalFork" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToEvaluate" sourceRef="Gateway_EvalFork" targetRef="Task_EvaluateApplication" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToProcessFees" sourceRef="Gateway_EvalFork" targetRef="Task_ProcessFees" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EvaluateToJoin" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateApplication" targetRef="Gateway_EvalJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeesToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProcessFees" targetRef="Gateway_EvalJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_EvalJoin" targetRef="Gateway_Decision" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accepted" name="Accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${accepted}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Task_SendRejection" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RejectionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="End_Rejected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptanceToConfirm" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Task_ConfirmEnrollment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmToDeadline" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmEnrollment" targetRef="Gateway_ConfirmDeadline" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmed" name="Confirmed" sourceRef="Gateway_ConfirmDeadline" targetRef="Gateway_OnboardFork">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${enrollmentConfirmed}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeadlineMissed" name="Deadline missed" sourceRef="Gateway_ConfirmDeadline" targetRef="Task_CancelApplication" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CancelToEnd" sourceRef="Task_CancelApplication" targetRef="End_Canceled" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToOrientation" sourceRef="Gateway_OnboardFork" targetRef="Task_SendOrientation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToAccounts" sourceRef="Gateway_OnboardFork" targetRef="Task_SetupAccounts" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToIntlSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_OnboardFork" targetRef="Gateway_IntlSplit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_International" name="International" sourceRef="Gateway_IntlSplit" targetRef="Task_VisaProcessing">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${international}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInternational" name="Not international" sourceRef="Gateway_IntlSplit" targetRef="Gateway_IntlMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaToIntlMerge" sourceRef="Task_VisaProcessing" targetRef="Gateway_IntlMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IntlMergeToJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_IntlMerge" targetRef="Gateway_OnboardJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrientationToJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendOrientation" targetRef="Gateway_OnboardJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountsToJoin" sourceRef="Task_SetupAccounts" targetRef="Gateway_OnboardJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToStudentID" sourceRef="Gateway_OnboardJoin" targetRef="Task_ObtainStudentID" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToStudyPlan" sourceRef="Task_ObtainStudentID" targetRef="SubProcess_StudyPlan" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToAttend" sourceRef="SubProcess_StudyPlan" targetRef="Task_AttendClasses" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToAddDropSplit" sourceRef="Task_AttendClasses" targetRef="Gateway_AddDropSplit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddDrop" name="Add or drop" sourceRef="Gateway_AddDropSplit" targetRef="Task_AddDropCourses">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${addDropChange}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAddDrop" name="No change" sourceRef="Gateway_AddDropSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AddDropMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddDropToMerge" sourceRef="Task_AddDropCourses" targetRef="Gateway_AddDropMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPostGrades" sourceRef="Gateway_AddDropMerge" targetRef="Task_PostGrades" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToReviewGrades" sourceRef="Task_PostGrades" targetRef="Task_ReviewGrades" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToGrievanceSplit" sourceRef="Task_ReviewGrades" targetRef="Gateway_GrievanceSplit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Grievance" name="Grievance" sourceRef="Gateway_GrievanceSplit" targetRef="SubProcess_Appeal">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${grievanceFiled}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoGrievance" name="No grievance" sourceRef="Gateway_GrievanceSplit" targetRef="Gateway_GrievanceMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AppealToMerge" sourceRef="SubProcess_Appeal" targetRef="Gateway_GrievanceMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToSemesterRepeat" sourceRef="Gateway_GrievanceMerge" targetRef="Gateway_SemesterRepeat" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextSemester" name="Continue to next semester" sourceRef="Gateway_SemesterRepeat" targetRef="SubProcess_StudyPlan" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Graduated" name="Graduated" sourceRef="Gateway_SemesterRepeat" targetRef="End_Graduated">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${graduated}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Withdrawn" name="Withdrawn" sourceRef="Gateway_SemesterRepeat" targetRef="End_Withdrawn">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${withdrawn}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
